literal: That summer, on dingchou day of the fourth month, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.
idiomatic: That summer, on dingchou day of the fourth month, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.

literal: On wuyin day the coffin halted at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the coffin halted at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.

literal: On jiashen day he halted at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin ahead to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On jiashen day he halted at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin ahead to the Supreme Capital.

literal: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent his younger brother Li Hu with troops to resist him.
idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent his younger brother Li Hu with troops to resist him.

literal: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he halted at the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent swift messengers asking to serve as vanguard.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he halted at the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent swift messengers asking to serve as vanguard.

literal: Reaching Taide Spring, he met Li Hu's army and defeated it.
idiomatic: Reaching Taide Spring, he met Li Hu's army and defeated it.

literal: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both armies to counsel reconciliation.
idiomatic: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both armies to counsel reconciliation.

literal: In the intercalary month of autumn, the seventh month, he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and they faced off for several days.
idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh autumn month he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and the two sides faced off for several days.

literal: Following Wuzhi's plan, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: Following Wuzhi's counsel, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.

literal: Soon after, hearing the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.
idiomatic: Soon after, hearing the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.

literal: Minister of Agriculture Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.
idiomatic: Minister of Agriculture Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.

literal: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's clansman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and appointed a xiangwen to oversee it.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's clansman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and appointed a xiangwen to oversee it.

literal: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on meritorious supporters; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty; Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.
idiomatic: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on those who had raised him to the throne; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty, and Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.

literal: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated without crime, were restored to them.
idiomatic: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated though guilty of no crime, were restored to them.

literal: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was first established, with Anpo appointed to it.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was established for the first time, with Anpo appointed to the post.

literal: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was buried at Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was buried at Huai Mausoleum.

literal: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed; the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed, and the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.

literal: A general amnesty was granted, and the first year of Datong was changed to the first year of Tianlu.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was granted, and the first year of Datong was changed to the first year of Tianlu.

literal: His deceased father was posthumously titled Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.
idiomatic: His deceased father was posthumously titled Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.

literal: Anduan was made to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage as Prince of Taining; Liu Ge as tiyin; Gao Xun as Southern Palace Commissioner.
idiomatic: Anduan was set to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage was made Prince of Taining; Liu Ge was made tiyin; and Gao Xun was made Southern Palace Commissioner.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli died of illness in prison.
idiomatic: In the third year, spring, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli died of illness in prison.

literal: On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Civil and military officials alike were promoted one rank.
idiomatic: Civil and military officials alike were promoted one rank.

literal: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.
idiomatic: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.

literal: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.
idiomatic: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.

literal: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month the ministers were summoned to discuss a southern campaign.
idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month the ministers were summoned to discuss a southern campaign.

literal: In the tenth winter month generals were dispatched with troops to capture Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, marched through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and took many captives.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month generals were dispatched with troops to capture Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, marched through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and took many captives.

literal: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance at court.

literal: That month the Directorate of Government Affairs was established.
idiomatic: That month the Directorate of Government Affairs was established.

literal: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.
idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.

literal: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he went to Shanxi.
idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he went to Shanxi.

literal: In the tenth winter month he personally led a southern campaign, captured Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned with great spoils.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he personally led a southern campaign, captured Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned with great spoils.

literal: That year Lady Xiao was installed as empress.
idiomatic: That year Lady Xiao was installed as empress.

literal: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness, contrary to circumspection; he surely had the ways that bring ruin.
idiomatic: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness and contrary to circumspection; he surely had within him the ways that bring ruin.

literal: Yet he was filial, friendly, lenient, and kind, and possessed something of a ruler's measure.
idiomatic: Yet he was filial, friendly, lenient, and kind, and possessed something of a ruler's measure.

literal: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!
idiomatic: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!
